notes:
The movie page grew up, and the player picked up a handful of the things you've
been asking for.

- **Trailers, cast and collections on every movie.** Open a film and there's a
  big **trailer** on the right that plays right inside the app — the server
  grabs it ahead of time, so it starts instantly in a clean, stripped-down
  player. On the left, the **synopsis** and the **cast** with photos (click
  anyone to open them on IMDb). And when a film is part of a series, its whole
  **collection** is there: the ones you already own are marked *In your library*
  and jump straight to their page, the ones you're missing get a **Find it**
  button into Add media, and anything not out yet shows *Coming <year>* instead.
  It's laid out in two columns on a wide window and folds to one when narrow,
  with a much larger title across the top.
- **Hold to fast-forward.** Press and hold anywhere on the video to run at 2×
  (like YouTube) and let go to drop back — with a little "2×" badge while you
  hold.
- **A play/pause flash.** Tapping the video shows a quick, fading play or pause
  icon in the middle, so you can see what your click did.
- **Skip buttons for the mouse.** On-screen back / forward 10-second buttons,
  alongside the arrow keys.
- **Rate it while it's fresh.** When a movie finishes, the app offers to rate it.
- **Straight to Home.** If you're already signed in, the app opens on Home
  instead of flashing the sign-in screen first.
- **(Admin) Download controls.** In Add media you can pause/resume a download and
  nudge its priority up or down, and the free space left on the library drive
  shows at the top of the list.

Fixes:

- **Minimizing no longer stops your video.** Sending the window to the taskbar
  and bringing it back keeps the film playing right where it was, instead of
  leaving a blank screen.
- The player no longer briefly builds and throws away a video engine when you
  double-click something to play it.
